summary.canonicalDatabaseContract: No differences identified in the inspected canonical vs_* catalog contract. All 9 function body MD5s and character counts match the canonical source; signatures, flags, client permissions and the 4-table structure match inspected canonical declarations.
summary.productionReportRpc: Absent: public.vs_report_result and genie_reporting_private do not exist.
summary.purge: Present, active and last five observed scheduled runs succeeded. The function matches canonical two-calendar-month poll retention and seven-day quota cleanup.
summary.edge: ACTIVE version 2. Source uses the OpenAI Responses API with store:false; exact model and actual environment CORS allowlist remain unknown.
summary.runtimeCompatibility: Not proven. No production application request or OPTIONS request was sent; actual Auth, Data API and Android CORS settings were not obtained.

canonical.comparisonMethod: Read local canonical function bodies between $function$ delimiters. Compare UTF-8 source-body MD5 and character count with pg_proc.prosrc metadata; manually compare returned catalog declarations and permissions to canonical SQL. No live application rows queried.
canonical.caveat: Matching MD5 plus character count is a comparison result, not an independent cryptographic byte-equality proof of all deployment files or runtime configuration.

retention.commandExplanation: The first raw-string comparison against a trailing-semicolon form was false. A follow-up allowlisted normalization confirmed exactly one schema-qualified SELECT public.vs_purge_expired() with only case/whitespace/optional trailing-semicolon normalization, not extra SQL.
retention.scheduleLocal: Daily 03:10 Asia/Seoul (18:10 UTC on the previous UTC date)
limits: Success metadata proves the scheduled function completed, not a row-by-row deletion audit.
No claim about Auth-account, backup, automatic platform log, or AI-provider retention.

arguments.query:
select
  current_timestamp as observed_at_utc,
  current_setting('server_version') as server_version,
  exists(select 1 from pg_catalog.pg_namespace where nspname = 'genie_reporting_private') as reporting_schema_exists,
  exists(select 1 from pg_catalog.pg_proc p join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace
    where n.nspname='public' and p.proname='vs_report_result') as reporting_rpc_exists,
  (select extversion from pg_catalog.pg_extension where extname='pg_cron') as pg_cron_version,
  to_regclass('cron.job') is not null as cron_job_catalog_exists,
  to_regclass('cron.job_run_details') is not null as cron_run_catalog_exists,
  (select array_agg(c.relname order by c.relname) from pg_catalog.pg_class c
    join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace
    where n.nspname='public' and c.relname like 'vs\_%' escape '\' and c.relkind in ('r','p')) as vs_tables;

select json_build_object(
 'tables', (select json_agg(json_build_object('name',c.relname,'rls',c.relrowsecurity,'force_rls',c.relforcerowsecurity,
  'owner',pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner),'anon_select',has_table_privilege('anon',c.oid,'SELECT'),
  'anon_insert',has_table_privilege('anon',c.oid,'INSERT'),'authenticated_select',has_table_privilege('authenticated',c.oid,'SELECT'),
  'authenticated_insert',has_table_privilege('authenticated',c.oid,'INSERT'),'authenticated_update',has_table_privilege('authenticated',c.oid,'UPDATE'),
  'authenticated_delete',has_table_privilege('authenticated',c.oid,'DELETE'),'service_role_insert',has_table_privilege('service_role',c.oid,'INSERT')) order by c.relname)
  from pg_catalog.pg_class c join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace
  where n.nspname='public' and c.relname in ('vs_polls','vs_votes','vs_user_limits','vs_daily_total') and c.relkind='r'),
 'columns', (select json_agg(json_build_object('table',c.relname,'position',a.attnum,'name',a.attname,
  'type',format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),'not_null',a.attnotnull,'default',pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid)) order by c.relname,a.attnum)
  from pg_catalog.pg_class c join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace
  join pg_catalog.pg_attribute a on a.attrelid=c.oid and a.attnum>0 and not a.attisdropped
  left join pg_catalog.pg_attrdef d on d.adrelid=c.oid and d.adnum=a.attnum
  where n.nspname='public' and c.relname in ('vs_polls','vs_votes','vs_user_limits','vs_daily_total')),
 'constraints', (select json_agg(json_build_object('table',c.relname,'name',co.conname,'type',co.contype,
  'definition',pg_get_constraintdef(co.oid,true)) order by c.relname,co.conname)
  from pg_catalog.pg_constraint co join pg_catalog.pg_class c on c.oid=co.conrelid join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace
  where n.nspname='public' and c.relname in ('vs_polls','vs_votes','vs_user_limits','vs_daily_total')),
 'indexes', (select json_agg(json_build_object('table',tablename,'name',indexname,'definition',indexdef) order by tablename,indexname)
  from pg_catalog.pg_indexes where schemaname='public' and tablename in ('vs_polls','vs_votes','vs_user_limits','vs_daily_total')),
 'policies', (select json_agg(json_build_object('table',tablename,'name',policyname,'roles',roles,'command',cmd,'using',qual,'check',with_check) order by tablename,policyname)
  from pg_catalog.pg_policies where schemaname='public' and tablename in ('vs_polls','vs_votes','vs_user_limits','vs_daily_total'))
) as catalog;

select p.proname as name,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) as identity_arguments,
 pg_get_function_result(p.oid) as result_type,l.lanname as language,p.prosecdef as security_definer,
 p.provolatile as volatility,
 (select array_agg(v) from unnest(coalesce(p.proconfig,array[]::text[])) v where v like 'search_path=%') as search_path_settings,
 (select count(*) from unnest(coalesce(p.proconfig,array[]::text[])) v where v not like 'search_path=%') as other_setting_count,
 md5(p.prosrc) as source_md5,length(p.prosrc) as source_characters,
 has_function_privilege('anon',p.oid,'EXECUTE') as anon_execute,
 has_function_privilege('authenticated',p.oid,'EXECUTE') as authenticated_execute,
 has_function_privilege('service_role',p.oid,'EXECUTE') as service_role_execute,
 exists(select 1 from aclexplode(coalesce(p.proacl,acldefault('f',p.proowner))) a where a.grantee=0 and a.privilege_type='EXECUTE') as public_execute
from pg_catalog.pg_proc p join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace join pg_catalog.pg_language l on l.oid=p.prolang
where n.nspname='public' and p.proname like 'vs\_%' escape '\' order by p.proname,identity_arguments;

select json_build_object(
 'observed_at_utc',current_timestamp,
 'timezone',current_setting('cron.timezone',true),
 'launch_active_jobs',current_setting('cron.launch_active_jobs',true),
 'log_run',current_setting('cron.log_run',true),
 'jobs',(select json_agg(json_build_object('jobid',j.jobid,'name',j.jobname,'schedule',j.schedule,'active',j.active,
  'command_matches_canonical',btrim(j.command)='select public.vs_purge_expired();','command_md5',md5(j.command),
  'last_success_in_7_days',(select max(r.end_time) from cron.job_run_details r where r.jobid=j.jobid and r.status='succeeded'
    and r.start_time>=current_timestamp-interval '7 days'),
  'recent_runs',(select json_agg(q order by q.start_time desc) from (
    select r.status,r.start_time,r.end_time from cron.job_run_details r where r.jobid=j.jobid
    and r.start_time>=current_timestamp-interval '7 days' order by r.start_time desc limit 5)q)
 ) order by j.jobid) from cron.job j where j.jobname='vs-purge-expired')
) as cron_status;

select json_build_object(
 'function_flags',(select json_agg(json_build_object('name',p.proname,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),
  'strict',p.proisstrict,'returns_set',p.proretset,'default_argument_count',p.pronargdefaults,
  'leakproof',p.proleakproof,'parallel',p.proparallel,'kind',p.prokind) order by p.proname)
  from pg_catalog.pg_proc p join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace
  where n.nspname='public' and p.proname like 'vs\_%' escape '\'),
 'non_internal_triggers',(select json_agg(json_build_object('table',c.relname,'name',t.tgname,'enabled',t.tgenabled) order by c.relname,t.tgname)
  from pg_catalog.pg_trigger t join pg_catalog.pg_class c on c.oid=t.tgrelid join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace
  where n.nspname='public' and c.relname in ('vs_polls','vs_votes','vs_user_limits','vs_daily_total') and not t.tgisinternal),
 'custom_rules',(select json_agg(json_build_object('table',c.relname,'name',r.rulename) order by c.relname,r.rulename)
  from pg_catalog.pg_rewrite r join pg_catalog.pg_class c on c.oid=r.ev_class join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace
  where n.nspname='public' and c.relname in ('vs_polls','vs_votes','vs_user_limits','vs_daily_total')),
 'client_privileges',(select json_agg(json_build_object('table',c.relname,'role',roles.name,
  'select',has_table_privilege(roles.name,c.oid,'SELECT'),'insert',has_table_privilege(roles.name,c.oid,'INSERT'),
  'update',has_table_privilege(roles.name,c.oid,'UPDATE'),'delete',has_table_privilege(roles.name,c.oid,'DELETE'),
  'truncate',has_table_privilege(roles.name,c.oid,'TRUNCATE'),'references',has_table_privilege(roles.name,c.oid,'REFERENCES'),
  'trigger',has_table_privilege(roles.name,c.oid,'TRIGGER')) order by c.relname,roles.name)
  from pg_catalog.pg_class c join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace
  cross join (values('anon'),('authenticated'))roles(name)
  where n.nspname='public' and c.relname in ('vs_polls','vs_votes','vs_user_limits','vs_daily_total') and c.relkind='r')
) as behavior_catalog;
